thread:
Maya: Quick poll + ops ask — we need to lock the webinar slate and greenroom cueing. Top candidate topics: 1) Cost-aware inference + live batching demo, 2) Multi-region reliability with real customer case, 3) Model rollouts & observability + canary demo. Pick your top 2. Also we need: speaker list, 40/10 timing, one live demo + 1 fallback, and a greenroom cue script. Abstracts due EOD Wed. @Sam @Jordan please weigh in.
Sam: I vote 1 & 3. Live batching demo shows concrete cost wins. For fallback, run a recorded demo with knob toggles.
Jordan: +1 to Sam. Also recommend pairing with a short observability panel — Priya from Platform and DevRel to cover rollout story.
Elena: Timing question — agree on 40min talk + 10 QA. We should define run-of-show bullets and exact handoff language for greenroom (who mics, who screenshares). Will the slides use the new company template?
Ash: I can draft the greenroom cue script and fallback matrix. Proposal: live demo on dedicated infra, fallback = prerecorded + step-by-step annotated snippet. Canary demo > prod hit. I’ll put together a 1-page doc.
Maya: Awesome — assign: Sam (demo plan + recording steps), Jordan (panel + speaker invites), Ash (greenroom script + fallback matrix), Elena (slide template + run-of-show). Deadline: abstracts + slide outline by Wed EOD. Canopy: please create calendar invite for the dry run.
deploy-bot: Event created: "Webinar dry run — slate/practice" on Thu 2026-03-26 15:00 PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/3456
Jordan: Greenroom cue snippet (example):
```
00:05 - Host: "You are live in 2 minutes, mics muted until go."
00:02 - Tech: "Slides ready, screen share queued, demo infra warmed."
00:00 - Host: "Go live on 3, 2, 1..."
```
Elena: Love the snippet — can we schedule dry run Thu 3pm PT? I can make it then.
Sam: Ack, 3pm PT works for me :thumbsup:
